name: What is the difference between a contractor and a designer for a bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a contractor and a designer for a bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A contractor, like Frasheski Construction, manages the construction and implementation of your renovation project, including scheduling tradespeople, overseeing the work, and ensuring it meets building codes. A designer focuses on the aesthetic and functional layout, selecting materials, colors, and fixtures to create a cohesive look. Often, contractors work closely with designers, or can provide design input themselves.
acceptedAnswer.description: A contractor manages construction, while a designer focuses on aesthetics and layout; both can collaborate on a bathroom renovation.
